articles.title: FACE Amusement Group Wins IAAPA Brass Ring Award for Best Talent Acquisition Program
articles.summary: FACE Amusement Group, a multi-location FEC operator based in Johnson City, TN, has been recognized by IAAPA for its innovative approach to recruiting, developing, and retaining staff across its entertainment portfolio. The award highlights workforce strategy as a competitive differentiator in the FEC sector. For operators struggling with hiring and retention, this recognition signals that structured talent programs can yield industry-wide recognition and operational advantages.

articles.title: accesso Launches Agentic AI for Automated Workflows in Visitor Attractions
articles.summary: accesso Technology Group has introduced agentic AI capabilities within its accesso Intelligence platform, enabling visitor attractions to automate analysis, forecasting, and reporting tasks. The new tools are designed to reduce manual workload for operations teams and improve decision-making speed across FEC and attraction businesses. This is a significant development for FEC operators evaluating AI-driven tools to boost efficiency without adding headcount.

articles.title: 24 Indoor Launches Monkey Town Indoor Play Brand in UK with Three October Openings
articles.summary: Netherlands and Germany-based indoor play operator 24 Indoor is formally entering the UK market in October 2026 with three simultaneous Monkey Town venue openings. The brand is already well-established in Continental Europe as a family-focused indoor play destination. This expansion signals growing investor confidence in the UK indoor entertainment market and raises the competitive bar for existing FEC operators in the region.

articles.title: Launch Entertainment Opens at Texas Mall with Trampolines, Arcade, and Duckpin Bowling
articles.summary: Launch Entertainment is set to open a new venue at Golden Triangle Mall in Denton, Texas, combining trampoline attractions, arcade games, and duckpin bowling under one roof. The mall-based location illustrates the continued trend of FEC operators filling anchor retail vacancies with experiential entertainment. Duckpin bowling in particular continues to gain traction as a differentiating amenity for modern FECs.

articles.title: PowerPlay FEC Permanently Closes
articles.summary: PowerPlay Family Entertainment Center has shut its doors, according to a report in RePlay Magazine. The closure adds to a pattern of smaller, single-location FECs facing viability challenges in an increasingly competitive market. Operators should monitor the factors behind closures like this one as indicators of market pressure points and cost management risks.

articles.title: Experience Economy Matures: Industry Leaders Weigh In on What Comes Next
articles.summary: Industry leaders say the experience economy has shifted from emerging trend to established industry, with IP-driven attractions, reimagined venues, and live events redefining guest expectations. Key questions now center on creative integrity, commercial sustainability, and global expansion strategy. FEC operators should pay close attention as these macro trends directly shape consumer spending patterns and competitive positioning.

articles.title: Gröna Lund Unveils SCORE! Interactive Dark Ride with Radar-Based System for 2027
articles.summary: Stockholm's Gröna Lund has announced SCORE!, a new interactive dark ride for 2027 developed with Jora Vision and featuring a first-of-its-kind radar-based ride system from Vekoma. Guests become the main characters in an immersive gaming adventure, blurring the line between gaming and physical attraction. The radar interaction mechanic represents a meaningful technology evolution that could influence future FEC and indoor attraction design.

articles.title: ProSlide's ATRIUM Innovation Lets Indoor Water Parks Extend Rides Beyond Their Walls
articles.summary: ProSlide has unveiled ATRIUM, a dome-shaped fiberglass enclosure that allows the TornadoWAVE 60 water ride to extend outside a building's footprint while maintaining an indoor experience with natural light. Launched at IAAPA Expo Europe in partnership with Aqualibi Belgium, the innovation helps indoor water parks optimize interior square footage by relocating large ride components outdoors. This is a valuable space-efficiency solution for FEC operators planning or renovating indoor water attractions.

articles.title: ProSlide Debuts ATRIUM at IAAPA Expo Europe, Expanding Indoor Water Park Design Options
articles.summary: ProSlide Technology introduced ATRIUM at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026, a structural innovation enabling the TornadoWAVE 60 ride to extend outside the building envelope while preserving the year-round indoor ride experience. By moving one of the ride's largest components outdoors, operators can reclaim valuable interior space for other revenue-generating attractions. The debut with Aqualibi at Walibi Belgium provides a real-world proof of concept for indoor water park developers.

articles.title: Center Parcs Launches Free Sensory Library for Neurodivergent Children at UK Resort
articles.summary: Center Parcs has introduced a Sensory Library at its Elveden Forest village, offering families free access to noise-reducing ear defenders, calming lights, visual timers, and other sensory tools with no diagnosis required. The initiative, developed with specialist SEN consultancy SENNIES, is planned to roll out across all six UK and Ireland villages by 2028. FEC operators can take note of this inclusion-forward approach as a practical, low-cost strategy to broaden appeal to neurodivergent families.

articles.title: Apex Entertainment Signs College Basketball Stars in NIL Partnership
articles.summary: Apex Entertainment has added Syracuse basketball players Sadiq White Jr. and Olivia Schmitt to its NIL (Name, Image, Likeness) program, leveraging college athletics partnerships to drive brand awareness. The strategy reflects a growing trend of FEC brands using athlete partnerships to reach younger, sports-oriented demographics. This is an accessible marketing model that smaller FEC operators could adapt for local or regional college team partnerships.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Moves Toward Build-Out in Jacksonville's Southside Commons
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park is progressing through approvals and planning stages for a new facility in Jacksonville, Florida's Southside Commons development. The project represents another example of adventure park concepts anchoring mixed-use retail and entertainment destinations. FEC developers and investors will want to track this as a case study in navigating municipal approvals for large indoor entertainment builds.

articles.title: First Renderings Released for MADCAPS Family Entertainment Center in Maricopa, Arizona
articles.summary: New renderings have been unveiled for MADCAPS, an upcoming family entertainment center planned for Maricopa, Arizona, giving the public a first visual look at the concept. The release of renderings typically signals a project entering active development and community engagement phases. FEC operators and suppliers in the Southwest market should monitor this development for potential competitive and partnership implications.

articles.title: Indian FEC Reopens After Major Redevelopment
articles.summary: An Indian family entertainment center has completed a significant redevelopment and reopened to the public, according to Amusements & Attractions. The project reflects accelerating investment in upgraded FEC infrastructure across India's growing leisure market. Suppliers and international operators eyeing expansion into South Asian markets should take note of this development activity.

articles.title: Playaza Entertainments Plans 10 New FEC Outlets Across South India in 18 Months
articles.summary: Playaza Entertainments has announced an aggressive expansion plan to open 10 new family entertainment venues across South India within the next 18 months. The rollout signals strong demand growth in India's indoor entertainment sector and growing confidence among domestic operators to scale quickly. Global FEC suppliers and equipment manufacturers should view this as a significant sales and partnership opportunity.

articles.title: Indian Entrepreneur Drives Indoor Entertainment Growth Through Indigenous Manufacturing
articles.summary: ET Now profiles Ankur Maheshwary and his work driving India's indoor entertainment industry forward through locally manufactured amusement and FEC equipment. The focus on indigenous production aims to reduce import dependency and lower costs for domestic FEC operators. This trend could reshape supplier dynamics across the rapidly expanding Indian FEC market.

articles.title: India's Largest Indoor Go-Karting Track Secures ₹24 Crore Construction Order
articles.summary: Complete Sports & Management Limited has won a ₹24 crore order to construct what will be India's first and largest indoor go-karting track. The project underscores the surging appetite for premium, large-scale indoor attractions in the Indian leisure market. FEC operators and go-kart suppliers globally should watch India's emerging track development pipeline as a growth indicator.

articles.title: Former Big Lots Space in Wenatchee to Be Converted into Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: A vacant Big Lots retail location in Wenatchee, Washington is being redeveloped as a family entertainment center, continuing the national trend of FECs moving into vacated big-box retail spaces. This type of conversion offers operators large footprints at potentially favorable lease rates in established retail corridors. It is a model other FEC entrepreneurs and developers may find worth studying.

articles.title: Alabama Adventure Adds Family-Friendly Fall Festival Alongside FearFest for Halloween Season
articles.summary: Alabama Adventure is splitting its Halloween programming into two distinct experiences: FearFest for thrill-seeking guests and the new Adventure Fall Festival targeting children and families. This dual-track strategy allows the park to maximize attendance across age demographics during the lucrative fall season. FEC operators planning Halloween events can take cues from this segmented approach to broaden their seasonal audience.

articles.title: Efteling Unveils Ravenring, World's First Vekoma WaveCatcher Interactive Family Ride
articles.summary: Efteling in the Netherlands has announced Ravenring, the debut installation of Vekoma's new WaveCatcher ride system, opening December 1 in the park's renewed Raveleijn area. The attraction combines dynamic movement with rider-controlled interaction, offering a new benchmark for interactive family ride experiences. Suppliers and designers serving the FEC and indoor attraction market should monitor how this new platform performs and whether it scales to smaller venues.

articles.title: New Workshop Helps Attractions Industry Teams Explore Sustainability and Business Risk
articles.summary: Valumia founder M. Verónica Celis Vergara has launched Paper Trail, a card-based facilitated workshop that helps attractions industry teams understand how investment, procurement, operations, and supply chain decisions are interconnected. Players take on roles including park operators, suppliers, and investors, working together to develop a resilient amusement park scenario. FEC leadership teams looking for practical sustainability and risk-management training will find this a relevant professional development option.

articles.title: Morey's Piers Executive Elected to IAAPA Global Board Leadership Track
articles.summary: Denise Beckson of Morey's Piers has been elected Second Vice Chair of the IAAPA Global Board of Directors, placing her on track to become Board Chair in 2029. Her election reinforces the prominence of regional FEC and pier-based operators within global industry governance. FEC operators engaged with IAAPA will want to note this leadership shift as it may influence future policy and programming priorities.

articles.title: Indoor Sports and Restaurant Concept Planned for East Cobb, Georgia
articles.summary: A new indoor sports and dining concept is in the planning stages for East Cobb, a suburban area of metro Atlanta, according to East Cobb News. The combined sports and restaurant format reflects growing consumer demand for activity-based dining destinations. FEC operators in the Southeast market should track this project as it represents a format competing for the same family leisure dollar.

articles.title: Chimelong Spaceship Theme Park Integrates 300+ Robots for Entertainment and Guest Services
articles.summary: China's Chimelong Group has deployed more than 300 robots from AgiBot across its Chimelong Spaceship park in Zhuhai, covering entertainment performances, guest interaction, education, and hotel operations. Robots perform martial arts and tai chi, play table tennis with guests, answer questions, and provide directions throughout the property. While large-scale deployment of this kind is currently limited to major theme parks, it previews a trajectory for robotics in guest experience that FEC operators and tech suppliers should monitor.

articles.title: United Parks & Resorts Promotes Kyle Miller to President
articles.summary: SeaWorld and Busch Gardens parent company United Parks & Resorts has elevated Kyle Miller from chief parks operating officer to president, while promoting Scott Maupin to fill the COO role. Miller brings over three decades of operational experience within the company and will work closely with CEO Marc Swanson on growth strategy. Leadership changes at major multi-park operators like United Parks often signal strategic shifts that influence supplier relationships, capital investment, and industry trends.

articles.title: KAIQI Offers Turnkey FEC Design and Direct Factory Installation Services
articles.summary: Equipment manufacturer KAIQI is promoting its turnkey family entertainment center design service, which combines customized space engineering with direct factory installation to streamline venue build-outs. The offering targets entrepreneurs and developers looking for a single-source solution from concept to opening. FEC operators planning new builds or expansions should evaluate turnkey suppliers like KAIQI as a way to manage cost and complexity.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 Draws Industry to London's ExCeL
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 took place at ExCeL London, bringing together attractions industry professionals from across the continent and beyond for product launches, networking, and knowledge sharing. Multiple major announcements were made at the show, including new ride systems, technology partnerships, and expansion plans. FEC operators who could not attend should review the week's announcements closely for innovations and supplier updates relevant to their businesses.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 Brass Ring Best Exhibit Award Winners Announced
articles.summary: IAAPA has announced the winners of the Brass Ring Best Exhibit Awards from its 2026 European expo, recognizing outstanding booth presentations across multiple categories on the show floor. These awards highlight which suppliers are leading in innovation and presentation within the global attractions industry. FEC operators sourcing new equipment or technology partners should review the winners as a shortlist of leading vendors.
